title: Solutions Engineer - Greece
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a Solutions Engineer to guide enterprise customers in Greece, designing innovative solutions that address real business challenges. Collaborate with technical experts and Account Executives, leveraging your deep technical expertise in Cisco’s technology portfolio. Ideal for candidates with significant pre-sales experience and strong English and Greek skills.
description:
Meet The Team

Join a vibrant and motivated team supporting some of the largest enterprise customers in Greece! This team thrives on collaboration, mutual support, and a culture that values both success and enjoyment. You will work closely alongside Account Executives, partnering to create meaningful strategic outcomes. The team includes technical experts across Cisco’s architectures, ensuring you have a strong network to lean on and grow with. You are passionate about architecting solutions that solve real business problems and thrive in competitive, fast-evolving environments. You enjoy learning new technologies and are eager to be hands-on with customers and partners. 

Your Impact

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will be the trusted technical guide for a big Private Sector account, representing the full breadth of Cisco’s technology portfolio. Your work will directly shape customer success by designing solutions that address real-world challenges. You will collaborate with partners, customers, and internal teams to drive innovation and growth, making a tangible difference in how organizations connect and protect their data in the AI era and beyond. This role is hybrid but also involves being in the field, engaging in-person with customers, partners, and your team at customer sites approximately 50% of the time.

Minimum Requirements

You bring at least five years of pre-sales experience in one or more of Cisco’s key technical areas, such as Enterprise Networks, Data Center & Cloud, Collaboration, Artificial Intelligence, or Security. 

Proven experience in the IT industry with deep technical expertise (+5 years)

Cisco Certification and/or industry certifications are valued (e.g., CCNA, CCIE certifications or equivalent.)

Experience leading technical presentations or customer meetings, with examples of successful outcomes 

English and Greek proficiency 

Being located in and authorized to work in Greece

Preferred Requirements 

Previous experience at Cisco or with Cisco Portfolio 

Engineering degree or equivalent background

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
